DuplexProviderStage checks text bound for the session before sending it, each chunk of assistant text before forwarding it, and each completed assistant turn; a firing is stamped on the message's validations, and an enforcing guardrail rewrites the turn, marks it finish_reason: safety and drops its tool calls (PromptKit v2.18.0 pipeline/stage/stages_duplex_provider_hooks.go)

Enforcement cannot unsay what was played; an enforcing streaming check drops the rest of the turn's text and audio; spoken input is not checked before the provider hears it (PromptKit v2.18.0 pipeline/stage/stages_duplex_provider_hooks.go:14-37,426-462)
RecordingStage comes after the provider stage, so a recorded turn holds the enforced content, and each assistant turn is recorded once
Duplex runs execute pack evals at conversation end: turn triggers per assistant turn, then session and conversation triggers
